firefox.local_host_note: Local macOS 27 Firefox launch was blocked before app loading; equivalent full test suite passed on Linux CI.

sidebar_regression.scope: Supplemental validation after the original 22-scenario cross-browser baseline. The complete suite now contains 24 tests; historical Firefox evidence remains 22 tests.
sidebar_regression.problem: The fixed desktop sidebar lacked an independent scroll container. At short viewport heights, its sign-out control could sit below the viewport and could not be brought into view.
sidebar_regression.fix: Enable vertical sidebar scrolling with contained overscroll. Hide the decorative purpose card and reduce footer padding on desktop viewports no taller than 850 px.
sidebar_regression.regression_evidence: The 1600x800 case failed before the CSS change because sign-out remained outside the viewport. Both cases passed after the change, following receipt, pantry table scrolling, received inventory scrolling, impact report navigation and sign-out.

local_chromium_full_suite.evidence: Local Playwright terminal output; duration rounded to reported 20.1 seconds.
